name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
eligibility: All landholding farmers with cultivable land
application_mode: Online at pmkisan.gov.in or through Common Service Centres

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops; loanee farmers mandatory
benefit: Premium 2% for Kharif; 1.5% for Rabi; 5% for commercial crops; full coverage for losses
application_mode: Nearest bank branch or CSC or PMFBY portal
documents_required: Land records + Sown crop certificate + Bank account
deadline_type: Before cutoff (varies by season and crop)

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
benefit: Revolving credit for crop production and allied activities; interest subvention at 4-7%
documents_required: Land records + Photo ID + Land revenue receipts

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
benefit: Free soil testing; fertilizer recommendation card; GPS-mapped test results
application_mode: Through nearest KVK / Agriculture office / Soil Testing Lab
documents_required: No formal application; field visit by agricultural officer

name: Sub Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
eligibility: All farmers; SC/ST and small farmers get priority
benefit: 50-80% subsidy on agricultural machinery (tillers, transplanters, reapers, drones)
application_mode: State Agricultural Department / TNAU district offices
documents_required: Application form + Land records + Bank account + Aadhaar

name: ATMA (Agricultural Technology Management Agency)
benefit: Training camps; exposure visits; demonstrations; farmer-to-farmer extension

name: NABARD Kisan Vikas Patra
benefit: Doubles investment in ~115 months; safe fixed return instrument

name: National Food Security Mission (NFSM)
benefit: Subsidy on seeds, fertilizers, micronutrients, farm machinery; cluster demonstrations

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)
eligibility: All farmers; SC/ST and small/marginal farmers get priority
benefit: 50-90% subsidy on drip and sprinkler irrigation systems
documents_required: Land records + Water source proof + Bank account

name: TN Chief Minister Uzhavar Pathukappu Thittam
benefit: State-specific insurance covering gaps in PMFBY; specific to TN market conditions

name: eVelanmai (Agricultural Advisory)
benefit: Free agricultural advisory by SMS / WhatsApp / portal in Tamil; location-specific advice

name: Integrated Pest Management (IPM) Programme
eligibility: All farmers especially with high pesticide use
benefit: Free bio-agents (Trichogramma, NPV); training on IPM practices; subsidized bio-pesticides
application_mode: Plant Protection office / District Agriculture office

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY) - Organic Farming
eligibility: Farmer clusters of 20 farmers; 50 acre minimum per cluster
benefit: Rs. 50000/ha over 3 years for conversion to organic; PGS-India certification support
application_mode: Through District Agriculture Department cluster formation

name: PM-AASHA (Assured Price Support Scheme)
eligibility: All farmers producing notified oilseed and pulse crops
benefit: MSP procurement when market price falls below MSP; deficiency payment option
application_mode: Register at NAFED procurement centers; TNSCO for TN
documents_required: Land records + Crop sown certificate + Bank account
contact: NAFED / Tamil Nadu State Civil Supplies Corporation

name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY)
eligibility: States / Farmer groups via State plan projects
benefit: Infrastructure grants for pack houses, cold chains, FPO support; farmer training
application_mode: State Planning Department; through district offices
documents_required: Project proposals via district agriculture office
